parameters.content:
## Project autoresearch
Configured ideathon → literature / novelty reflection → proposal → configured approvals → approved Kaggle run.
Hybrid and full-agent settings come from the saved project grant.
Set goal, presets, Library context and limits in the project Workflow tab. Start there to issue a saved grant.

## Every agent request uses the Agent loop workflow
The model chooses one action; Workbench executes it in the approved SSH session and verifies its receipt.
Literature search/reflection, citation gathering, VLM images and paper reviews use dedicated stage presets through this loop.
Run finishing: summaries → references → plots → LaTeX with visual reflections → image/caption/reference and duplicate checks → text review.
